+title: 'Elicitation task 39a: show a notice in the deck for a withdrawn request'
+---
+Accepted by the step owner with card 39 (^pvng650), answers Q5 and Q6. Design: section 3 and test plan 5C of /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-wballard-github-swissarmyhammer-AgentViewKit/43998bc3-6f4e-4bb7-909b-93c5172edb4f/scratchpad/card39-design.md. Write all text in STE.
+
+## Design
+- Data: `WithdrawnRequest` (id, request, reason), `SessionModel.withdrawnRequests`, `ConnectionModel.withdrawnRequests`, `dismissWithdrawn(_:)` (ACPClient fdd66eb, which card 39 brings in).
+- `DeckCards` shows one row for each record of its model, in withdrawal order, above `DeckHeader`.
+- Row text: "<title> was withdrawn: <reason>". With no reason: "<title> was withdrawn." The title is the same text as `PendingRequestSummary(request:)`.
+- The row copies `NoticeBanner` (SessionNoticeBanner.swift): `SharedSymbol.information`, `editorTheme.tint(for: .info)`, glass, and a Dismiss button (`SharedSymbol.dismiss`) that calls `dismissWithdrawn(id)`.
+- Identifiers: `request-deck-withdrawn-<id>` and `request-deck-withdrawn-dismiss-<id>` (RequestDeck.withdrawnIdentifierPrefix, withdrawnDismissIdentifierPrefix, identifier(forWithdrawn:)).
+- The row stays until the user presses Dismiss. A new request does not remove it. The row takes no focus.
+- Announcement: the row text one time, at `.default` priority.
+- A deck with only rows shows the rows and the deck padding (this changes the empty-deck rule).
+- Docs: change Docs/decisions/accessibility.md:52 and :84 (line 84 says that a withdrawn request gives no announcement).
+- Known risk: after a reconnect, an old withdrawn record can appear in a new connection (an ACPClient gap).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add `ScriptedSession.sendCancelRequest(id:reason:)` that sends a `$/cancel_request` frame with `_meta.reason`.
+- [ ] Wait with `ObservationWait.until { !model.withdrawnRequests.isEmpty }`, then `render()`. Check the row label and one `RecordingAnnouncer` entry at `.default`.
+- [ ] Press Dismiss; then require synchronously that `model.withdrawnRequests.isEmpty`; then `render()` and expect no row.
+- [ ] A withdrawn request with no reason; a deck with only a row; the connection deck.
+- Rules: fixed order; no clock wait, sleep, poll, retry or timeLimit; hosted suites .hostedSerially; after each press a synchronous require before any wait. #elicitation-phase-6
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    Research done. Facts:
+    - ACPClient fdd66eb: the agent sends `$/cancel_request` with params {requestId, _meta:{reason}} (key CancelRequestNotification.reasonMetaKey = "reason"). WithdrawnRequest.reason is nil when _meta has no string under that key. The request leaves pendingRequests first; the record comes in a later main-actor step, when the task of the request resumes. Only a `$/cancel_request` of the agent makes a record. A resume start or a close empties the list (session); a close or a new connection empties it (connection).
+    - WithdrawnRequest has no public init. Thus the pure text function takes raw values (title, reason).
+    - AnnouncementPriority has no `.default` case. Its cases are low, medium, high. VoiceOverAnnouncer posts `.medium` with the `.default` speech priority. Thus the announcement uses `.medium`, which is the `.default` speech priority of the design.
+    - NoticeBanner is used only by SessionNoticeBanner and SymbolConceptTests. To not copy its body, the plan is to move its layout into one shared glass row view that both NoticeBanner and the withdrawn row use.
+    - The hosted connection deck test uses ScriptedSession.openWithLoginElicitation(id:); the agent lead-in sends that elicitation, because sendInOrder(_:) targets a SessionModel only.
